Сыграй вничью с компьютером. Он всегда х: Get a draw against the computer. It always moves first: on early floors in the center, on later floors in the center or a corner.
Computer in the center: take any corner. Computer in a corner: take the center.
Дальше просто закрывай каждую линию, где: Then just block every line where it already has two marks.
Секрет: поднимись по лестнице в глубине: Secret: climb the stairs at the back of the room and pull the lever. The leafy wall left of the board opens, with a chest behind it.
Три NPC и три сундука. Каждый что-то гов: Three NPCs and three chests. Each says something about the reward, and someone is lying. Only one chest can be opened.
Кликни по каждому NPC и открой сундук то: Click each NPC and open the chest of the one who said one of the phrases below.
Фразы того, у кого награда: Phrases of the one with the reward
На стенах и потолке висят Sea Lantern. В: Sea Lanterns hang on the walls and ceiling. A bow shot links two lanterns with a beam.
Соедини 4 пары фонарей так, чтобы все 4: Link 4 pairs of lanterns so that all 4 beams pass through the Creeper in the center.
Пара всегда на противоположных сторонах: A pair is always on opposite sides of the room: look through the Creeper.
Когда все 4 луча готовы, Creeper взрывае: Once all 4 beams are set, the Creeper explodes and opens a chest with Blessing V.
Пять дверей к сундуку, три закрыты. Вода: Five doors to the chest, three of them closed. Water that flows into the hole of a door's color toggles that door.
Шесть цветных рычагов двигают блоки в ла: Six colored levers move blocks in the maze, the lever at the back of the room turns the water on and off.
Сначала выставь блоки, потом пускай воду: Set the blocks first, then release the water: all 5 doors must be open at the same time.
Вода в отверстии уже открытой двери закр: Water in the hole of an already open door closes it, and you can get locked in. Way out: Spirit Leap to a teammate or help from outside.
Моды с решателем показывают нужный поряд: Mods with a solver show the right lever order.
Семь комнат по четыре телепорта. Нужно п: Seven rooms with four teleport pads each. You need to reach the center room with the chest.
После каждого телепорта ты смотришь на п: After each teleport you face the pad that leads to the center, but it is usually in another room.
Иди на пад по диагонали от того, на кото: Take the pad diagonal to the one you arrived on. When you end up facing a pad in the same room, it leads to the center.
Высокая комната с 10 Blaze, у каждого св: A tall room with 10 Blazes, each with different HP. They must be killed strictly in order.
Сундук внизу — бей от меньшего HP к боль: Chest at the bottom: hit from lowest HP to highest. Chest at the top: from highest to lowest.
A Blaze out of order fails the puzzle.
Не бери Runaan's Bow и Hurricane Bow: ли: Don't use Runaan's Bow or Hurricane Bow: extra arrows hit the wrong Blazes.
Лучнику (Archer) лучше удочка или меч: е: An Archer is better off with a fishing rod or a sword: their arrows bounce.
Секрет — за водопадом перед верхом лестн: The secret is behind the waterfall before the top of the stairs, on the bedrock.
Комната заставлена ящиками 3×3 с кнопкам: The room is full of 3×3 boxes with buttons. You can't walk over the boxes: glass appears under your feet.
Кнопка толкает ящик в противоположную от: A button pushes the box away from it. A box at the back wall disappears when pushed.
Обычно хватает сдвинуть пару ящиков по к: Usually moving a couple of boxes on the sides is enough to open a path to the chest.
Ящик, упёртый в другой ящик, назад не сд: A box pushed against another box can't be moved back: the puzzle can get stuck. Think before every press.
Silverfish с TNT на голове стоит на скол: A Silverfish with TNT on its head stands on a slippery floor. It has to be guided to the gate.
Ударь silverfish: она скользит по прямой: Hit the silverfish: it slides straight in the direction you face until the first wall.
Продумай маршрут от ворот назад, к silve: Plan the route backwards, from the gate to the silverfish.
Trap ставить нельзя: попытка остановить: No Traps: trying to stop the silverfish with a trap fails the puzzle.
Статуя Oruo the Omniscient задаёт три во: The statue Oruo the Omniscient asks three SkyBlock questions. Answer by clicking an option in chat.
Все три ответа верны — команда получает: All three answers right: the team gets Blessing of Time with Health, Defense, Strength and Intelligence.
Ещё Oruo заполняет Training Weights и до: Oruo also fills Training Weights and adds an hour to Bottle of Jyrre and Dark Cacao Truffle.
Брат на Spider's Den — Rick, брат Rick —: Brother on Spider's Den: Rick, Rick's brother: Pat. Stained glass vendor in the Hub: Wool Weaver.
Улучшает питомцев — Kat. Lady of the Net: Upgrades pets: Kat. Lady of the Nether: Elle. Rogue Sword in the Village: Jamie.
Вопросы про число Fairy Souls и минионов: Questions about the number of Fairy Souls and minions change with patches: check the game.
Три уровня льда. Каждый блок льда нужно: Three levels of ice. Each ice block must be walked over exactly once to turn into Packed Ice.
Не прыгай, не ходи по диагонали и не нас: Don't jump, move diagonally or step on a block twice: the ice cracks and the level restarts.
Иди медленно: на бегу игра может засчита: Walk slowly: when running, the game may count a diagonal step.
The reward is two blessings at once.
В каждом данже минимум две загадки — фио: Every dungeon has at least two puzzles: purple rooms on the Magical Map, no repeats. A solved one gives the team Blessing V, a failed one costs 14 points. A failed puzzle can be reset with Architect's First Draft from secret chests.
Секреты — какая доля секретов этажа даёт: Secrets: the share of a floor's secrets that gives the full 40 Explore points. Time: how long you can take without losing Speed points.
Смерть −2 (первая с Legendary Spirit — −: Death −2 (the first with a Legendary Spirit: −1), failed puzzle −14. Boss not killed: the whole score −30%.
60 — за долю зачищенных комнат (все мобы: 60 for the share of cleared rooms (all starred mobs), 40 for secrets up to the floor's quota.
Полные 100, пока укладываешься в лимит э: Full 100 while within the floor's time limit. Then one point per 12–40 seconds.
Crypts: по очку за каждый взорванный скл: Crypts: one point per blown-up crypt with Crypt Undead (Superboom TNT), up to 5.
С F6 в каждом данже один секретный сунду: From F6, one secret chest in every dungeon is a Mimic. Kill it.
Шанс от атрибута Reborn (Prince Shard) п: A chance from the Reborn attribute (Prince Shard) when killing a Prince, a stronger Crypt Undead.
When Paul is mayor with the EZPZ perk.
Оценки: S+ — 300 и больше, S — от 270, A: Ranks: S+ is 300 and up, S from 270, A from 230, B from 160, C from 100. With everything else maxed, S+ survives up to 2 deaths on F1–F5 and up to 3 on F6–F7.
Секретов пока нет: они в бурых и оранжев: No secrets yet: they are in brown and orange rooms and in some puzzles.
Виды: сундук (двойной считается за два),: Types: chest (a double chest counts as two), item on the ground, bat (kill it yourself) and Wither Essence (right-click). A Journal Entry is not a secret.
Каждый секрет даёт очки Explore: до 40 з: Each secret gives Explore points: up to 40 for the floor's quota. F7 and Master Mode need all secrets, F1 only 30%.
Из секретов падают Spirit Leap, Decoy, T: Secrets drop Spirit Leap, Decoy, Trap, Inflatable Jerry, Defuse Kit, Architect's First Draft, and from F4 Dungeon Chest Key and Treasure Talisman.
Комната со всеми найденными секретами от: A room with all secrets found gets a green check on the Magical Map; the room's secret counter is above the hotbar.
Часть секретов спрятана за стенами под S: Some secrets hide behind Superboom TNT walls, behind levers and up high: Aspect of the Void and Grappling Hook help.
The order from the entrance to the boss.
Ключ падает с минибосса (Lost Adventurer: The key drops from a miniboss (Lost Adventurer, Angry Archaeologist and others) or when all starred mobs in a room are dead. Any player can use it on a door.
Падает так же. За дверью — Blood Room. О: Drops the same way. Behind the door is the Blood Room. Usually one player rushes the key and opens it (blood rush) while the others clear rooms.
Убей всех Undead, The Watcher неуязвим: Kill all Undead, The Watcher is invulnerable
Watcher призывает мертвецов из витрин на: The Watcher summons the dead from the display cases on the walls. You win when all are dead. Don't hit him: he answers with a laser.
Фраза «That will be enough for now.» зна: The line «That will be enough for now.» means no more summons. A dead player becomes a Wandering Soul: kill it and they revive (unless there is a Healer).
F3 — призывает Bonzo. F4 — Watchful Eyes: F3: summons Bonzo. F4: Watchful Eyes hit anyone standing on the pillars, and Scarf may come.
F5 — мобы с модификатором. Boomer при см: F5: mobs with a modifier. Boomer drops TNT with True Damage on death: step away. Spirit Bear also appears.
F6 — модификатор не объявляют, приходит: F6: the modifier isn't announced, Livid appears. F7: no pillars, one of Sadan's giants comes first.
После победы над Watcher открывается пор: After the Watcher is beaten, the portal to the floor's boss opens. Clear rooms and grab secrets before entering: there is no way back from the boss room.
Усиление всей команды до конца захода. З: A buff for the whole team until the end of the run. Puzzles and mobs give level V, secrets I–II, same ones stack. Strength grows with the floor; in Master Mode it matches the same normal floor.
S+ даёт больше опыта Catacombs и лучший: S+ gives more Catacombs XP and better loot. Usually missing: secrets ({0} needs {1}%), Crypts (5 of them), or someone fails puzzles.
Подставь цифры из таблицы Tab во время з: Enter the numbers from the Tab list during a run: secrets found (%), rooms cleared (%), time. The calculator shows the score and what is missing for S+.
